subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` path display by default, switch agent/tool outputs to full absolute paths by default, or add an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve compact home-relative display, while the request asks for a default UX policy change with possible config-surface and compatibility implications.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt guidance so user-visible file references under home render as full absolute paths.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Add a documented setting or env var for users who want full absolute paths while keeping current defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the central shortening behavior and is the strongest history-backed candidate for the display-policy choice.
